control.recommendation: New normal-D2 bridge rooted at latest accepted/published product a4dc at this read snapshot, with the SAME reviewed normal benchmark driver/content/config/oracle added to both products. Freeze new clean SHA/tree on each side; a4dc is only a proposed root, never a ready control APP.
control.finalSelection: Compare final integrated normalD2 against that normal bridge only after exact request/state/trace and shared runtime equivalence. Final product and control remain null.
control.comparability: Same normal timing/text/effects/media policy, business workload, resolved seeds, formal App ports, runtime/window/DPR and observation policy. Every changed product/payload path has both hashes and rationale. If a metric has changed semantics or no valid bridge, mark NOT_COMPARABLE for that metric; preserve raw candidate results and paired obligation OPEN.
control.notControl: Historical D1 fast/legacy or old canonical package is historical only; no extra mandatory D1 launches. Current preparation commit is not a product/control measurement commit.

runs.normal: No expose-gc and zero forced calls, no cache clearing or full-state reset between cases.
runs.off: Adjacent pair retains semantic/oracle and production perf; disables new fine probes. Fine frames/memory NOT_SAMPLED, not zero; no off p95 PASS.
runs.GC: Separate single diagnostic pair; expose-gc only here; two actual calls at each initial/after4/after50/after100/idle120 point, require success evidence.
runs.qualification: Outside formal groups; exact case/trace IDs and version; all attempts retained. Full100 qualification only when static normal branch bounds cannot otherwise be proved.

host.priorDenial: Original occupancy ps check denied; exact command/receipt retained by parent. No retry, alternative process listing, different runner, UI or inference of idle in this task.
host.futureGate: Only after materially new relevant authorization, outcome check, and one permitted retry of the original known-unexecuted denied operation. A lease or user approval alone is not a successful occupancy receipt.
host.lease: Named executor, bounded UTC window, no concurrent local build/test/NW/heavy GUI. Re-read all live ownership before reservation; cloud-only comparison work may continue if it does not contend locally.
host.occupancy: Only reviewed narrow original host gate; no whole-machine ps replacement, no killing unrelated tasks. Query unavailable/denied => no launch.
host.ownedSampling: After actual Popen identity only: exact PID/PGID plus birth identity, executable, recursive direct descendants and renderer binding. Race/partial/denied => null+UNKNOWN and reason. No global process scan or name sums.
host.capabilitySplit: Unresolved occupancy/owned-cleanup admission blocks launch; an optional RSS sample failure after valid admission records UNKNOWN, never substitutes Renderer RSS.

beforeRun: exact driver/validator/supervisor and input bytes/canonical Node JSON.stringify hash
resolved content/config/locale/expected ordered100 IDs and all seeds
Showdown7244fe8 lock+actual staged/build, Gen8, Reactor fixed source and runtime hashes
both strict deep signatures and signing policy; no widening binary exclusions
exact CI H/tree/branch/event/attempt/jobs+steps and review disposition
identity.differencePolicy: Replace D1 three-path allowlist with independently reviewed exact per-path control+candidate hashes and source reason; preserve engine/SDK/locale changes if legitimate, do not whitelist whole directories.
identity.afterRun: Full APP files/modes/dirs/links and strict signatures before/after even on failure. Binding to exact raw report, group ID, input nonce, start/end UTC and PID lineage; mutation invalidates the group.
identity.state: Actual Node JSON.stringify+crypto and package core validateGame; no Python float substitution/field removal/time normalization. Preserve every case full state+ledger receipt for independent middle-row hashes; formal overlay must disclose oracle overhead in both modes.

metrics.waitSeparation: Record union of actual intentional-wait intervals (not sum of overlapping tracks), raw total and exposed nonwait. Preserve all slow frames; not CPU attribution; never deduct post-hoc expected waits from an unrelated endpoint.
memory: browser JS heap bytes or null
actual owned whole-app tree RSS bytes or null
metrics.units: Raw bytes and explicit /1048576 MiB. Original canonical MB label/method preserved; no silent reinterpretation of old rounded units.
metrics.aggregation: Compute each process independently then median of three natural summaries; never pool natural/GC/off or substitute rAF for updateMain. Positive comparable baseline may use +20%; nonpositive growth ratios are N/A, report raw differences.
metrics.coverage: No physical input, audio listening, allocation/CPU attribution, Windows/Intel, complete D2/E/5.4 acceptance by this report.

presentationTargets.meaning: Existing semantic targets, not measured times or new hard perf budgets; preflash/postwait/return-map0.4s recorded separately. Never skip waits to hit a performance number.

deadlines.formula: Finite process bound = qualified launch upper + sum(all100 enumerated intentional critical-path upper bounds + reviewed per-kind nonwait/input upper bounds) + idle120 game ticks bound + bounded sampling/verification/tail budgets. All components, safety factors, raw qualification sources and final numeric value must be frozen/reviewed before running.
deadlines.branchGate: Cover later progression/receiving/level branches, not just first4. If static enumeration is unavailable, one separately labelled full100 qualification per version supplies traces; never substitute expected state or call a failed formal run qualification afterward.
deadlines.noLegacy900: Old D1 900-second limit is not accepted for normalD2 without proof. Timeout stops and preserves; no post-failure extension or automatic rerun.

thresholds.historicalCanonicalRows: Unchanged in docs/step5/perf-budget.json; compare only identical measurement method/units. Old159ms excludes deliberate4s presentation and cannot bound totalD2.

historicalMemory100.label: memory: app RSS growth from 4 to 100 battles (MB)

baseline.method: Same fresh ad-hoc foreground baseline package; 25 rounds x 4 kinds, --js-flags=--expose-gc, every sample gcForced=true; DPR 2, zero skipped unfocused frames and positive battle/map frame samples.

historicalMemory100.note: Current fourth-step baseline replaces the second-step hardened historical reference. One 100-battle run and rounded MB samples cannot establish or rule out a leak; report the curve and warn only.

thresholds.pairedD2: Matched rows > control natural median*1.2 are WARN; frame long33ms is descriptive, not an invented hard failure. Ratios for nonpositive control are N/A.
thresholds.historicalGCWarn: +23.8929% remains OPEN, one pair; no leak conclusion

failure.firstError: Retain original business/fatal/timeout/signal separately from cleanup errors and later tail failures; any failure prevents next group.
failure.prelaunchDenied: No native attempt, signal, repeated occupancy or alternative check; independent file preparation may continue.
failure.finally: For attempted launch: reconcile uncertain outcome first; cleanup only proven owned group; final APP inventory/signature and after-idle as authorized. Receipt absent/permission denied remains UNKNOWN/FAIL_STOP. A denied query is not automatically retried by finally.
failure.cleanup: Record ownership, bounded TERM/grace/KILL policy before run; never signal uncertain/reused PID or nonowned helper. Exact owned group absence required; unknown means no next launch.
failure.preservation: New exclusive attempt roots; stdout/stderr/raw reports/progress/signal/RSS/hash-helper bytes/PID/exit/deadline/cleanup/tail records. Preserve partials and all old failures; no retry to green.
failure.acceptance: All100 exact IDs/order/expected outcomes, no fatal/timeout/mutation, actual exits, complete declared tails, independent review. Reproducible measurements/WARN disposition is P4 gate, not warning eradication.

continue: Separate functional producer -> ordinary isolated save -> producer exit/owned cleanup -> new profile+NW process actual Title/Continue/Scene_Load exact slot -> next real battle. Bind full state, explicit MZ fields, slot bytes, paired ledger, consumed vs temporary-held outcomes and no repeated install. Not counted among100 or proved by Node method-only Continue.
pureControlScope: Offline validator and in-memory finally reference controls only; neither accepts a host receipt nor launches NW. New normal native supervisor/driver NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
